priorBoundExplanation: Frozen logits = prior + residual, residual in [-8,8]. A prior-0 teacher-best action can be lowered only to -8, while a target with prior < -16 can rise only below -8. Thus priorGap > 16 + 1e-9 is counted as cannotOutscoreTeacherBestWithCurrentBound (strictly separated, cannot attain argmax). At exactly 16 the endpoints can tie; it is NOT labelled strictly unreachable. This is a necessary representability diagnostic, not proof that gaps <=16 are reachable by the network. Exact prior == -20 cases are counted separately. Resources/Bureaucracy are fixed in the current PPO; their prior-bound statistics are descriptive hypothetical bounds, not learned-policy failure claims.

Resource-order differences could preserve bought fuel, but identical bought fuel is NOT verified by these records. Controller labels/service counts also change by design.

independentNodeBoundaryCases.note: Fixed mathematical boundary probes, not extra game trials or saved training fixtures.

uncertainty.primaryEstimand: Equal-weight macro credit over 20 fixed Germany cells; average all focal seats within each deal first.
uncertainty.independentUnit: 40 paired independent deals (2 per cell), NOT 1600 independent games. Seat and arm repetitions share deals.
uncertainty.formula: For H fixed cells: mean = mean_h mean_d (seatMean(arm)-seatMean(control)); SE = sqrt(sum_h s_h^2/2)/H; s_h^2 uses ddof=1.
uncertainty.interval: Approximate normal point +/-1.96*unbiased stratified paired SE, without clipping or bootstrap.
caveats: Only two clusters per cell: each within-cell variance has ONE degree of freedom; normal intervals can be unreliable, especially in cells/subgroups.
Zero observed variance with two deals is limited information, not proof of zero uncertainty or effect equivalence.
All ten arms, five player counts, four rule pairs and 20 cells reported. No multiplicity correction; exploratory, not qualification.
All-reference 1/n per deal is an exact all-seat design identity. Its zero stratified SE is not certainty about general playing strength.
Decision counts are dependent observations along games, with correlated focal-seat/arm repeats; they are NOT independent Bernoulli trials. No naive decision-rate confidence intervals.
Each arm visits its own states. Phase-swap effects include downstream interactions and do not add up; diagnostic disagreement is not a causal per-action effect.
Stored summary legacy unstratified SEs were independently reproduced, but this report uses fixed-cell paired stratification.
Germany-only, fixed reference population, tiny diagnostic sample; no claims about other maps, humans, production or qualification.
No raw action traces were saved. Compact invariants checked for all outcomes, legality/routing replayed for ten; not an independent reconstruction of every recorded action.

conclusion: Auction and Building are the next learning targets, not production candidates selected from these diagnostic arms. Auction has substantial strict >16+epsilon prior-bound exclusions; Building has consequential phase-swap effects without such exclusions here. Resources/Bureaucracy show zero unreachable counters and small/zero macro effects. Equal Resource-swap macro/focal credits do NOT imply identical trajectories or all terminal vectors: reference Resource swaps preserve all 160 vectors but change 90 phase-counter signatures; teacher Resource swaps preserve all 160 focal credits but change 2 nonfocal terminal vectors and 84 phase-counter signatures. No arm is selected, promoted, or qualification-eligible.
